title: Capability to OneCLI grant mappings (S7 first values, P9)
note: Every right named here is reviewed. credentialRef is never a live OneCLI id (secretId/connectionId are per-project runtime values, not catalogue content) — it is the stable OneCLI field the trusted resolver matches against: a Secret's `type` for kind=secret, a Connection's `provider` for kind=connection (apps/broker/src/onecli verified live, 2026-09-06, apps/broker/README.md). tools is either the literal string "full" or an explicit tool id list from GET /apps/{provider}/permission-definition.
